$comment: Pre-configured departments (decision 113). The Orchestrator uses these names when work fits; any other department is still created as data. Each department's manager prompt is agents/departments/<key>.md, its skills are agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and its connectors are switched on in Settings -> Departments (POST /connectors with the url). Read by backend/src/aic/shared/presets.py and served to the HUD by GET /departments/presets.
